info.description: A single member resource card with an icon and a download or link button

icon.description: Icon name, e.g. FiDownload, FiCalendar, FiMail

file.description: Upload a file here for a download button (e.g. the Member Handbook PDF)

link.description: Internal path (e.g. /training/training-calendar) or full external URL. Ignored when a file is uploaded.
